title: Hinomori Shiho — Filled With My "Thanks"〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: A Gentleman Thief's Thrilling White Day?!

rows.Line: White Day
After school

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks for waiting.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's okay. We haven't been here long, so no problem♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm? Someone's excited about something...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki's been like this all day.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. My guess is that she can't wait to see what Tsukasa's prepared for her.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Yeah, because he invited the three of you, Emu and everyone else from Wonderlands×Showtime over to our house!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I didn't see Tsukasa getting anything ready, so I'm really excited about what he's gonna do for us!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay, okay. We get it.
There's still something else we need to do before that, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Happy White Day, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Saki, Honami & Shiho
rows.Line: Happy White Day!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Here's my gift...
It's an assortment of chocolate truffles in different flavors.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, the wrapping's so fancy!
It already looks delicious!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm not sure about that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. My gift is macarons.
I decided to try making some myself.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
You made these? They look amazing.
Aren't macarons really hard to make?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I've been meaning to try for a while.
They turned out really well, but make sure to eat them soon.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay! Thanks, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'll go next!
Ta-daa!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, you baked us muffins?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wait, these are huge.
They're mushrooming out of their cups.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I think I used a little too much dough♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. But I think you baked them just right. They look delicious.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
They baked all the way through and were good when I gave them a taste, so satisfaction guaranteed♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm sure they're fine.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, here's my gift...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, a simple box! That's so like you, Shiho. Can I open mine?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You'd peek inside regardless of what I say, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What? Well, maybe just a tiny peek through the unclosed gaps...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. An honest answer.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, come on! She made these with Haruka during that chocolate-making demo, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That means these are chocolates by Shiho for us! Of course I can't wait to see what's inside!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I agree. I can't wait to see either.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Alright, fine.
In return for what you did, Saki, go right ahead.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay♪ You're the best!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh wow! Chocolate shooting stars!
Th-That's so cool...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
You're right...!
They look so smooth! And these silvery decorations are so shiny!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
The silvery bits are edible silver leaf.
My hope was that adding these would make them look more like shooting stars.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, and you succeeded with flying colors!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm starting to think our wishes might come true if we made some on these stars.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, totally!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That might be taking it too far.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No, I disagree.
These really look like shooting stars.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah♪
I'm gonna make a wish before I eat mine!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I think I will too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'm glad they like them so much.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, Saki, why don't we start making our way towards your place...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. We shouldn't keep Tsukasa waiting.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, I'm gonna let him know that we're on our way!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We're meeting with Otori over there, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. She said she's going to meet with Kusanagi and the others at Kamiyama High right after homeroom lets out.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, that means the four of us should be fine on our own.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup♪ So it's off to my house!
Let's go, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, okay.
